title: Fill Size and Refill Timing Limits for Tailwise Pharmacy Classes
content:
Each Tailwise Pharmacy class limits how much one fill may contain, how soon the next fill may follow, whether a fill may be partial, and, for some classes, how much may be dispensed over the life of the prescription or how soon a compounded fill can ship.

## Limits by class

| Class | Maximum days' supply per fill | Refill-too-soon share | Partial fill allowed | Partial fill counts as a whole fill | Beyond-use days | Lifetime days' supply limit | Compounding lead time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | 180 days | 75 percent | No | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no limit beyond fills and validity) | 0 business days |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | 90 days | 75 percent | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no limit beyond fills and validity) | 0 business days |
| Rx Prescription Diet | 90 days | 70 percent | No | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no limit beyond fills and validity) | 0 business days |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | 30 days | 80 percent | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no limit beyond fills and validity) | 0 business days |
| Rx Controlled Substance | 30 days | 85 percent | No | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 180 days | 0 business days |
| Rx Compounded Medication | 30 days | 80 percent | No | Yes | 45 days | 0 (no limit beyond fills and validity) | 3 business days |

## Definitions

- **Maximum days' supply per fill**: the largest days' supply one fill may contain.
- **Refill-too-soon share**: the share of the previous fill's days' supply that must have elapsed before the next fill may be dispensed.
- **Partial fill allowed**: whether a fill may dispense less than the prescribed quantity per fill when the customer asks.
- **Partial fill counts as a whole fill**: whether a partial fill counts as a whole fill against the fills remaining on the prescription.
- **Beyond-use days**: days a compounded preparation stays usable after it is made; it caps the days' supply of one fill. 0 means not applicable.
- **Lifetime days' supply limit**: the largest total days' supply that may be dispensed across all fills of one prescription. 0 means no limit beyond the fills authorized and the validity.
- **Compounding lead time**: business days the compounding partner needs after authorization before the first fill can ship.

## Illustrations

- An Rx Compounded Medication fill is held to 30 days by the maximum per fill; its 45 beyond-use days do not lift that maximum.
- Over the life of one Rx Controlled Substance prescription no more than 180 days' supply in total may be dispensed, however many fills remain.
